 .whipTitle{color:#ffd58c;background:#3e3548;border-left:3px solid #f0bf71;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:6px;margin:12px 0 8px}.whipTitle + .equiprow{border-top:0} 
/* 3 section structured contents; 1 column in Part I, 2 vertical columns in Parts II/III */
.tocPart{margin:20px 0 24px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:var(--panel)}
.tocPart h3{margin:0 0 13px;font-size:18px;color:#e9efff}
.tocColumns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}
.tocColumns.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.tocColumn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;min-width:0}
.tocEntry{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:47px;color:#e9f3ff;background:#22334c;border:1px solid #455a76;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 11px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.tocEntry:hover{background:#344d6f}
.tocEntry .name{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:14px;font-weight:730}
.tocEntry .num{color:var(--mint);font-size:12px;min-width:24px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bossIcons{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.bossIcons img{object-fit:contain;width:38px;height:38px;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #0007)}
.stageTitle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0 8px}
.stageTitle h1{margin:0;flex:0 1 auto}
.stageTitle .bossIcons img{width:62px;height:62px}
.bossIconNote{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
@media(max-width:720px){.tocColumns.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tocPart{padding:12px}.stageTitle .bossIcons img{width:52px;height:52px}}

/* Added summon information only; existing navigation/equipment styles are preserved. */
.summonBox{border:1px solid #4f6785;border-radius:13px;background:#1a2b44;padding:12px 15px;margin:13px 0 20px}
.summonBox h3{margin:1px 0 10px;color:#e7f8ff;font-size:19px}
.summonEntry{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid #3a5069;flex-wrap:wrap}
.summonBoss{font-weight:800;color:#e9f3ff;min-width:120px;font-size:16px}
.summonCond{color:#d0dced;flex:1;min-width:200px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.summonItems{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.summonItem{border:1px solid #ff667a;border-radius:9px;background:#3a2133;color:#ff7d8f;font-size:14px;font-weight:750;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 9px}
.summonItem:hover{background:#532436}
.summonItem img{width:25px;height:25px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.summonNote{font-size:11px;color:#bccbdf;margin-top:4px}
.summonPlace{color:#50e9a1;font-weight:800}.summonTrigger{color:#ff7186;font-weight:800}

/* Only permanent boost screen: item icons, bosses and exact in-game registered crafting */
.boostCard{padding:13px 15px}.boostHeading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;margin:0 0 9px}.boostHeading>span:last-child{min-width:0}
.boostImage{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:48px;flex:0 0 48px;border:1px solid #47536c;background:#162337;border-radius:9px;padding:3px;vertical-align:middle}
.boostImage img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.boostImage.small{width:38px;height:38px;flex-basis:38px}.boostBossImage{display:inline-flex;vertical-align:middle;width:40px;height:40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 8px 0 6px}
.boostBossImage img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.boostAcquire{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:40px}.boostRecipes{margin:10px 0 14px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #46536a;border-radius:10px;background:#151f32}
.boostRecipes h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px;color:#e9d4fd}.boostRecipe{padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid #34445e}.boostRecipe:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.boostParts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
.boostPart{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.boostStations{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px}
.boostFurniture{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.boostOr{color:#a2b9ca;font-size:12px}.boostCard .badge{margin-top:6px}
@media(max-width:480px){.boostCard{padding:10px}.boostHeading{gap:9px}.boostImage{width:43px;height:43px;flex-basis:43px}.boostPart{font-size:13px}.boostParts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Additions limited to video stat boost, wing, event images and mini-tab navigation */
.videoTabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}.videoTabBtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:50px}
.vidSprite{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;vertical-align:middle;flex:0 0 44px;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid #4d5d78;border-radius:10px;background:#152137;padding:4px;box-sizing:border-box}
.vidSprite img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.vidSprite.small{width:35px;height:35px;flex-basis:35px}.vidSprite.large{width:58px;height:58px;flex-basis:58px}.vidSprite.missing{font-size:10px;color:#f5a1a1}
.videoTabBtn .vidSprite.small{width:31px;height:31px;flex-basis:31px}.videoBoostCard,.videoWingCard{padding:14px 16px}
.videoHead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.videoHead h3{margin:0}.videoHead .metadata{font-size:12px}.videoBoostCard p,.videoWingCard p{margin:9px 0}
.videoEffect{padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;color:#aef2dc;background:#153332;font-weight:750;margin:12px 0}
.videoMatGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:7px;margin:9px 0}
.videoMaterial{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #35455d;padding:6px 9px;min-width:0;font-size:13px}
.videoMaterial>span:last-child{overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-width:0}.videoStation{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;border:1px solid #35455d;padding:9px;border-radius:9px;margin:12px 0}
.videoStation strong{color:#cbb9ff}.videoStation .metadata{flex-basis:100%}
.videoWingStats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:13px 0}
.videoWingStats>span{border:1px solid #35445f;border-radius:8px;padding:9px;background:#13213a;font-size:13px}.videoWingStats b{display:block;color:#c4cef3;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:4px}
.videoWingRecipe{padding:11px;border:1px solid #3b5271;background:#141f32;border-radius:9px;margin:10px 0;font-size:13px}
.videoEventImg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.videoEventImg>.metadata{max-width:130px;line-height:1.3}
@media(max-width:570px){.videoTabBtn{min-height:48px}.videoHead{align-items:flex-start}.videoWingStats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.videoMatGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.videoEventImg>.metadata{display:none}}

/* 2026-11-26: boss information and equipment navigation; original DATA unchanged. */
.bossDropTable{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}.bossDropTable th,.bossDropTable td{padding:8px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;vertical-align:middle}.bossDropTable th{color:var(--mint);background:var(--card)}.bossDropTable .plate{width:36px;height:36px;flex:0 0 36px}.bossDropTable .plate img{width:29px;height:29px}.bossDropTable .lootName{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.bossDropWrap{overflow-x:auto}.bossDropTable td:nth-child(2),.bossDropTable td:nth-child(3){white-space:nowrap}.bossGroup{margin:15px 0}.bossRef{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.bossCraftBlock{margin:8px 0 18px}.bossDropTable .equipment{font-size:inherit}.bossEquipGo{margin-top:20px}.bossDropTable .stat{color:var(--mint)}@media(max-width:600px){.bossDropTable{font-size:12px}.bossDropTable th,.bossDropTable td{padding:6px 4px}.bossDropTable .lootName{gap:5px}.bossDropTable .plate{width:29px;height:29px;flex-basis:29px}.bossDropTable .plate img{width:23px;height:23px}}

/* Boss information / equipment horizontal transition and unified loot display only. */
.bossOriginList{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 12px;margin:4px 0 12px}.bossOriginEntry{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:15px}.bossOriginEntry b{font-weight:750}.stageTitle h1 .bossOriginEntry{display:inline;font-size:inherit;line-height:1.4}.stageTitle h1 .bossOriginMod{display:inline-block;font-size:14px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:5px}.stageTitle h1 .bossOriginEnglish{color:var(--ink)}.bossOriginEnglish{color:var(--muted)}.bossOriginMod{border:1px solid #62738e;background:#263852;border-radius:7px;padding:3px 8px;font-weight:750;color:#e9f3ff;white-space:nowrap}.bossOriginMod[data-mod="칼라미티 모드"]{border-color:#aa8255;color:#ffd58c;background:#42332a}.bossOriginMod[data-mod="카탈리스트 모드"],.bossOriginMod[data-mod="Hunt of the Old God"]{color:#dbcaff;background:#392c58;border-color:#8165b0}.bossViewNav .bossArrow{margin-left:0}.bossViewNav .bossArrow.back{margin-left:0}.lootRule{padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid #34435e;line-height:1.5}.lootRule:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}.lootRule:last-child{padding-bottom:0}.lootChannel{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#aef2dc}.lootChannel.bag{color:#c2a9ff}.lootOriginalName{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.bossSlideViewport{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}.bossSlideIncoming{position:relative;animation:bossSlideIn .32s ease-in-out both}.bossSlideOutgoing{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;pointer-events:none;animation:bossSlideOut .32s ease-in-out both}.bossSlideViewport[data-direction="right"]{--incoming:100%;--outgoing:-100%}.bossSlideViewport[data-direction="left"]{--incoming:-100%;--outgoing:100%}@keyframes bossSlideIn{from{transform:translateX(var(--incoming))}to{transform:translateX(0)}}@keyframes bossSlideOut{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(var(--outgoing))}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bossSlideIncoming,.bossSlideOutgoing{animation:none}}@media(max-width:600px){.bossViewNav .bossArrow{margin-left:0}.bossOriginEntry{font-size:14px}}

/* Mobile-only: prevent vertical loot names; stack each item's existing two cells. */
@media screen and (max-width:600px){
  .bossGroup .bossDropWrap{min-width:0;width:100%;overflow-x:auto}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable{display:block;width:100%;font-size:13px;min-width:0}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody{display:block;width:100%}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody tr{display:block;width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 0}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody tr:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody td{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:100%;white-space:normal;border-bottom:0;padding:5px 4px;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody td:first-child{background:var(--card);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 6px}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable tbody td:nth-child(2){padding:8px 6px 2px}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable .lootName{width:100%;min-width:0;gap:8px;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-weight:650}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable .lootName .equipment{flex:1;min-width:0;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:normal}
  .bossGroup .bossDropTable .lootRule,.bossGroup .bossDropTable .metadata,.bossGroup .bossDropTable .lootOriginalName{white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
}

/* Boss/detail equipment navigation only: floating toolbar, below the existing sticky header. */
@media screen {
  .bossViewNav{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--bossHeaderHeight, 74px) + 6px);z-index:95;align-items:center;padding:9px 10px;background:rgba(22,30,49,.97);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #0007;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .bossViewNav .btn{white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .bossSlideViewport .bossViewNav{position:relative;top:auto;z-index:auto}
}
@media screen and (max-width:600px){
  .bossViewNav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;padding:7px;top:calc(var(--bossHeaderHeight, 74px) + 4px)}
  .bossViewNav .btn{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:40px;padding:6px 5px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35}
  .bossViewNav .bossArrow,.bossViewNav .bossArrow.back{margin:0}
  .bossSlideViewport .bossViewNav{top:auto}
}

/* Desktop: fixed boss navigation, independent of document scrolling. */
@media screen and (min-width:601px){
  #root:has(> .bossViewNav){padding-top:calc(var(--bossDesktopNavHeight, 62px) + 10px)}
  #root > .bossViewNav{position:fixed;top:calc(var(--bossHeaderHeight, 74px) + 6px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(1300px, calc(100% - 40px));margin:0;z-index:95;justify-content:flex-start}
}

/* Crafting station icons only */
.craftStationPair{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;vertical-align:middle;max-width:100%;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:2px 0}.craftStationPair>span{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.craftStationIcon{width:34px;height:34px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;background:#162337;border:1px solid #47536c;border-radius:7px;padding:3px;flex:0 0 34px;vertical-align:middle}.recHead .craftStationPair{color:inherit}

.furnStationLink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;vertical-align:middle;color:inherit;background:transparent;border:1px solid #526681;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 7px;text-align:left;max-width:100%;font:inherit}.furnStationLink:hover{background:#334b65;color:#fff}.furnStationLink .vidSprite{flex-shrink:0}.furnStationLink span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* Small TOC navigation and named neighbouring stages only. */
.smallViewNav .smallNavActions,.smallViewNav .smallNavTabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}
.smallViewNav .smallNavTabs{flex:1 1 620px}.smallViewNav .videoTabBtn{min-height:40px;padding:6px 9px;font-size:13px;gap:5px}.smallViewNav .videoTabBtn[aria-current="page"]{background:#136554;border-color:var(--mint)}
.smallViewNav .smallNavActions .btn{font-size:13px;padding:6px 10px;min-height:40px}
.bossViewNav .stageNavNamed{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;max-width:330px;min-width:0;line-height:1.3}
